page.layout: One page of verse, centred lines with italic headings; running head at top; catchword "Quid" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse side and ink blots at left margin are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Illum noête vigil,stratis & manè reliêtis, Tempora sub mediæ lucis & occiduæ Ore canam feruens,& feruens pectore.Felix Musa,Dei laudes cui celebrare datur,
main_text.head: Inanis ostentatio doctrinæ.
main_text.p: Infinitorum librorum nomina narras: Doctrinæ tamen est guttula nulla tibi. Sic quidam nuper plantarum nomina multa Narrabat,cui vix brassica nota fuit.
main_text.head: Euonymus frutex. Præclara sine merito fama.
main_text.p: Diceris Euonymus,nec possum dicere quare: Dicere sed possum,Diceris Euonymus. Nobile nomen habent permulti:nescio quare: Hoc scio sed,quòd ij nobile nomen habent.
main_text.head: Eupatorium herba.
main_text.p: Glorior Eupatoris præstanti nomine:verùm Gloria mortales prima iuuare mihi. Permulti sunt,hinc qui nobilitantur & inde: At prodesse aliis maxima nobilitas.
main_text.head: Troglodyta. Sophista.
main_text.p: Sol oritur?maledicta parant in lumen amœnum, Antraque se condunt sub nigra Troglodytæ. Adueniunt tenebræ Phœbo latitante?nigrantes Extollunt tenebras laudibus innumeris. O,soboles Erebo veniens rabiosa,Sophistæ: Troglodytis merito vos ego dico pares. Aduenientem lumen Veri damnatis,opacas Futilibus nugis conuehitis tenebras.

page.notes: Marginal ink blots and manuscript-like smudges at left margin not transcribed. Several words, such as "Narrabat" and "Euonymus", are set with decorative capital letters; the first letter of "Infinitorum" and "Sic" overlaps a woodcut-like blot and is uncertain.
